description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the OpenmrsProfileIncludeFilter using unit tests. It specifically tests whether certain beans are correctly created or not based on the OpenMRS version profile.

classes.name: OpenmrsProfileIncludeFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that extends BaseContextSensitiveTest to verify the bean creation logic based on OpenMRS profile conditions.

methods.name: match_shouldCreateBeanForOpenmrs1_8AndLater
methods.description: Test method that confirms a bean of type OpenmrsComponent1_8 is created and not null when the profile is set to OpenMRS 1.8 or later.

methods.name: match_shouldNotCreateBeanForOpenmrs1_6To1_7
methods.description: Test method that asserts an exception is thrown when attempting to retrieve a bean for OpenmrsComponent1_6To1_7, indicating that it should not be created under certain profiles.
